newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices end mixed in lower volume.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices end mixed in lower volume.

text.p: Prices were mixed on the Istanbul Gold Exchange on Tuesday in slightly lower volume.
Gold gained $0.20 to end at $389.70 per ounce but held steady in lira terms at 1,081,000 lira per gram. Volume dropped by nine percent to 1,755 kilograms.
Dealers said seasonal demand from the free market, triggered by increased jewellery sales to tourists, continued to keep trade on the Exchange active.
They said prices went up in dollar terms on a higher gold price in London and were steady in lira terms as the lira firmed to 86,165 per dollar from the 86,200 Monday close.
There was 960 kilos of trade in the morning and 795 kilos of trade in the afternoon. --Istanbul Newsroom, +90-212-275 0875
